page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top; a marginal note at the left margin beside the paragraph "Subjunctivi passivi Praesens".

main_text.p: Futurum secundum, formatur à Futuro secundo indicativo: itidem ομαι in οιμην mutando. ut: τυπήσομαι, τυπησοίμην: δεδιπήσομαι, ἐλιχπησοίμην.
Paulo-post-futurum, formatur à Paulo-post-futuro indicativo: itidem ομαι in οιμην mutando. ut: πεπύψομαι, πεπυψοίμην: πεπαιοιήσομαι, πεπαιοησοίμεν: πεθείσομαι, πεθεισοίμην.

head.i: Sic igitur etiam formantur Tempora Optativi passivi.

main_text.p: II.Subjunctivi passivi Praesens, formatur à Praesente indicativo: o penultimae syllabae mutando in ω. ut: τυπτομαι, τυπτωμαι: ποιεομαι, ποιεωμαι: ἀιδομαι, ἀιδωμαι.
Sic etiam prima & secunda conjugatio in μι. ut: τιθεμαι, τιθωμαι: ἱσταμαι, ἱστῶμαι.
Perfectum, ut in Optativo, vel circumlocutione exprimitur. ut: τετυμμένος ὦ, λελυμένος ὦ, πεπεμμένος ὦ.
Vel formatur à Perfecto indicativo: penultimâ Vocali in ω circumflexum mutando. ut: γεγέμμαι, γεγεμῶμαι: κέκλεγ-μαι,

page.notes: Greek text is partly worn and several accents are uncertain; the marginal note "II." is a section marker. Greek words in the scan are transcribed approximately and marked as doubtful where unclear.
